'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Olaf Schroeder LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Olaf Schroeder]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Light. Transcription note: lines 39-40 numbered 37-38 on sheet; shields in shorthand

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' joe freedom
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
